_: The film's beats on its clock. Each part has its own clock, starting at 0. kind is title (a card, shown from t to until), action (something done on screen), answer (what the subject does in reply), or emotion (where the story stands: open, setup, hang, breath, turn, hit, fall, summit, coda, tie-back). sound is a word for what should be heard, or none. visible is never typed: the sync check measures it. Check with: node tools/beats.mjs check <this file>

beats.what: a terminal; a test run starts
one flag is added to the command
